description: Source code for the fsmonitor--daemon component of a Git extension, implementing filesystem monitoring daemon with IPC, thread management, and client command handling.

methods.name: fsmonitor_new_token_data
methods.description: Creates a new token data structure with an initial batch and unique token ID.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new batch structure.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__free_list
methods.description: Frees a linked list of batch structures.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__add_path
methods.description: Adds a path to a batch, interning the string.

methods.name: fsmonitor_batch__combine
methods.description: Merges paths from one batch into another.

methods.name: with_lock__truncate_old_batches
methods.description: Truncates old batches from the list based on time delay.

methods.name: fsmonitor_free_token_data
methods.description: Frees a token data structure and its associated batches.

methods.name: with_lock__do_force_resync
methods.description: Resets the token data, creating a new token and aborting cookies.

methods.name: fsmonitor_force_resync
methods.description: Locks and triggers a resync of filesystem state.

methods.name: with_lock__format_response_token
methods.description: Formats a response token string for client communication.

methods.name: fsmonitor_parse_client_token
methods.description: Parses a client-provided token string into token ID and sequence number.

methods.name: do_handle_client
methods.description: Handles client commands over IPC, including quit, flush, and token-based requests.

methods.name: handle_client
methods.description: Wrapper for handling incoming IPC client requests.

methods.name: fsmonitor_run_daemon_1
methods.description: Initializes and runs the main daemon threads for listening and health monitoring.

methods.name: fsmonitor_run_daemon
methods.description: Sets up daemon state and starts the filesystem monitoring daemon.

methods.name: cmd_fsmonitor__daemon
methods.description: Main command handler for starting/stopping/status of the fsmonitor daemon.
